Structuring a presentation

A presentation consists of three parts: ((++introduction result)), main part and conclusion. The main part is the ((++longest shortest)). At the end of a presentation, there should also be time for ((++questions games)) or a discussion.

atoms.text: It also makes sense to introduce the presentation with an attention-getter. This serves to attract the attention of the audience and arouse interest in the topic. It should always be short and topic-specific.

hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>attention-getter</voice> bedeutet Aufmerksamkeitserreger oder Aufmerksamkeitswecker.

instruction.text: Beantworte die Frage. Mehrere Antworten können richtig sein.

finish.text: Ein langes Video oder ausführliche Statistiken eignen sich eher nicht als attention getter, da sie zu viel Zeit des Vortrages beanspruchen und das Publikum schnell langweilen können.

atoms.a: Which of the examples are suitable as an attention getter?
Which picture should Kalea use as an attention-getter to start her presentation about “Environmental challenges”?
Which thought-provoking statement is more suitable to introduce the picture?

b.sound: 195 nations, 12 days of intense talks, and one goal—to secure our planet's future.
Polluted oceans, melting ice caps and vanishing forests - this is our harsh reality, not a future scenario.

instruction.text: Ordne nun die Aussagen den passenden Gliederungspunkten der Präsentation zu.

b.sound: Today, I am going to talk about some of the most severe environmental challenges, including climate change, pollution and the loss of biodiversity.

The pollution of our planet can be divided into air, water and soil pollution. Air pollution is caused by the release of pollutants into the air, such as gases, particles and chemicals. Major sources of air pollution are transportation, agriculture and industries.
All in all, one can say that environmental challenges are a serious threat to our way of life and to our whole planet.
Thank you for your attention! Are there any questions yet? If not, I'd like to discuss with you some ideas how each of us can live more environmentally-friendly.
